title: Make deploy/aws/Dockerfile install the version named by its VERSION build argument
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/deploy/aws/Dockerfile, change line 9 from RUN npm install -g mongodb-mcp-server@latest to RUN npm install -g mongodb-mcp-server@${VERSION}. Change line 3 from ARG VERSION=latest to an explicit released semver, and add a build-time guard that fails when VERSION is latest or empty (for example RUN test "$VERSION" != latest). Update the workflow that builds the AWS image (docker-publish.yml or docker.yml, whichever targets deploy/aws) to pass --build-arg VERSION=<release tag>, so the image label version=${VERSION} matches the installed package. Install from the allowed registry https://registry.npmjs.org only (dependencyPolicy.allowedRegistries). Promote through dev, then qa, then prod (releaseProcess.environmentsOrder). Do not retag already-published images.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -n '@latest' deploy/aws/Dockerfile returns no match, and the npm install line references ${VERSION}
docker build --build-arg VERSION=latest -f deploy/aws/Dockerfile . fails at the guard step
An image built by CI for a release tag reports the same version from npm ls -g mongodb-mcp-server inside the container as its version label

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-cicd-env for mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server. Expected: the CICD-PIN-03 finding no longer cites deploy/aws/Dockerfile, and the probe observation records that the npm install is pinned to the VERSION build argument.

rootCause.description: The AWS Dockerfile declares a VERSION build argument for labelling but hardcodes @latest in the install step, so every rebuild silently pulls the newest npm release no matter which version was requested.
